column1: # High always fails. "fix" = the edge or the service sets it, so an alert means a regression and fails.
# "accept" = listed with its reason, does not fail. An alert not listed here fails the gate.

column3: HSTS: APISIX adds Strict-Transport-Security to every HTTPS response (lua/edge-security-headers.lua)
Server version leak: APISIX runs with enable_server_tokens false
X-Content-Type-Options: services (SecurityHeadersFilter), the admin UI and the edge (edge errors) set nosniff
Anti-clickjacking: X-Frame-Options DENY from services, admin UI and edge errors
CSP: services and edge errors send default-src none; the admin UI sends its own CSP
X-Powered-By: the admin UI disables it (poweredByHeader false); services send none
Cookie without HttpOnly: the admin UI session cookie is HttpOnly
Cookie without Secure: the admin UI session cookie is Secure (HTTPS only edge)
Cookie without SameSite: the admin UI session cookie is SameSite
Storable/cacheable content: informational; APIs send Cache-Control no-store, static UI assets may be cached
Re-examine cache directives: static admin UI assets are immutable and cacheable on purpose
Information disclosure suspicious comments: hits are in the minified Next.js framework bundle, not ours
Timestamp disclosure: response fields carry ISO timestamps by design (createdAt, ts)
Modern web application: informational (the admin UI is a Next.js app)
Session management response identified: informational
Authentication request identified: informational (Keycloak login through the edge)
Base64 disclosure: correlation ids, ETags and Next.js build ids, no secret material
Permissions-Policy missing: APIs return JSON only; no browser feature is used. Revisit for the admin UI after MVP
Spectre site isolation (COOP/COEP/CORP) missing: no cross-origin embedding or shared memory; revisit after MVP
Cross-domain JavaScript source: none expected; accepted only for the Keycloak login page assets
CSP directive notes (wildcard/unsafe-inline style): Next.js needs inline styles; script-src is nonce/self
Cross-domain misconfiguration: no CORS allow-all on our routes; Keycloak well-known endpoints are public by design
Application error disclosure: edge 4xx/5xx bodies are the 5.3 envelope without stack traces
Absence of anti-CSRF tokens: the admin UI uses SameSite cookies + server actions origin check; APIs are bearer-token only
User-controllable HTML attribute: reflected values are escaped by React
User agent fuzzer: informational
Third-party content (Keycloak theme): informational
ZAP is out of date: the image is pinned on purpose (MW_ZAP_IMAGE in scripts/security.sh); bump it with the other pins
